capabilities.scope: On one operator-reported V1.2 sample, a battery-powered normal POWER-on boot from NOR reached the ESP_MOSAICO kernel and a single-user shell with an FFS memory-disk root. This does not establish NAND boot, full PSRAM read/write or general peripheral support.

On one operator-reported V1.2 sample, the net80211 scan cache reached 18 entries during one RAM boot's automatic scanning. Ten scan summaries recorded zero IEEE80211 bad-version drops and no ring-full, mbuf-allocation or node-allocation failures. These are BSD scan-cache entries, not the vendor callback's AP summary. A strict SAE/PMF-required profile remained in SCANNING/ASSOCIATING, with no IPv4 address or default route; its matching AP observation reported auth enum 7. WPA2/WPA3 authentication, DHCP and roaming are not accepted.
Type-C USB-OTG ROM connection and complete 16 MiB NOR readback verified with esptool 5.6.0. This does not establish an EmberBSD USB console or a successful firmware restore.

On one V1.2 sample, the standard CO5300 framebuffer/genfb/LVGL path displayed a visible interface after the published two-row RASET fix; the user also confirmed changing touch coordinates. This is one RAM-only scenario, not acceptance of other revisions. Touch orientation/calibration, audio playback and sustained operation remain unverified. Factory camera preview is vendor-firmware evidence; EmberBSD camera support remains identity-only with no DVP capture. EmberBSD radio evidence is limited to scan-path activity: WPA2/WPA3/PMF authentication, DHCP and roaming remain unverified.

On one V1.2 sample, the left-slot camera EEPROM descriptor had valid CRCs and hardware-version field 0x0102. The factory firmware separately reported SC101IOT PID 0xda4a and rendered a changing 1280 × 720 UYVY preview. The optional EmberBSD identity-only driver read SC101IOT PID 0xda4a at 0x68 in a RAM trial. DVP capture is not implemented, so this does not establish an EmberBSD camera preview. The factory and EmberBSD results apply only to this sample and do not establish sensor identity for other modules.
